title: Manchester United's Toney rumour masks a defensive problem
body:
Manchester United are reportedly eyeing a move for Al-Ahli striker Ivan Toney, one of several names in BBC Sport's Monday gossip column [S1]. The same column says Fulham are holding contract talks with Calvin Bassey, and that PSG could step up their pursuit of Eli Junior Kroupi [S1]. A companion piece casts United as targets for Bassey and Brentford's Nathan Collins [S2], while AC Milan want Real Madrid's Endrick on loan [S2].

The form table is where this gets uncomfortable. United's last five league games have brought no wins, three draws and two defeats, giving them 3 points, 6 scored and 11 conceded [ST1]. Fulham have been far steadier, with two wins, two draws and one defeat, collecting 8 points while conceding just 4 [ST2].

Any rebuild should start at the back, not the transfer column.

Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so treat every rumour with care. If this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
